messages:
maria: Quick check — do we have any spare H100 slots in eu-west1 for a 2h customer demo tomorrow afternoon? Vendor mentioned a small rack arrival but I don't know if it's cleared for Dedicated pools. Need quota + serials if available.

aj: Who's owning the eu pool this week? I can look up live usage if someone points me to the right tenant carve.

devops-bot: Ticket created: INFRA-4982 — 'eu-west1 demo burst capacity request (H100)'. Assigned to @aj.

tom: Usage looks light from 16:00-18:00 UTC — we have ~6 H100s free in standby but two are in 'hold' due to incomplete vendor manifest. Fallback plan: A40s available in the same AZ but slightly higher latency.

maria: Thanks Tom. We need H100s for perf parity on that demo. Can procurement unblock the hold? @alesha any invoice/manifest blockers?

alesha: Vendor flagged 2 racks pending customs clearance, ETA 12h. For the ones 'arrived' we still need serial attestations to remove hold — vendor ops must confirm L1 check. I've pinged @vendor-ops-bot for manifests.

vendor-ops-bot: Manifest uploaded to S3: s3://redwood-procure/manifests/eu/176999/manifest-1769998523.csv — contains serials and rack IDs. Status: awaiting customs release flag.

maria: Can someone paste the serials we could claim if customs clears? I want to pre-assign them to the demo tenant and open the quota request.

kelsey: Pulling from inventory dashboard — quick list (partial):
```
rack-17: H100-serial-HT3A21B4
rack-18: H100-serial-HT3A21C9
rack-19: H100-serial-HT3A21D0 (hold)
```
Only rack-19 shows a customs hold flag. If that clears we have 3 H100s free.

sree: For quota bump, please include exact serials + time window in the request. I can fast-track a temporary carve if you add 'demo-eu-west1' as tenant and set TTL to 3h. Example CLI we use to claim: 
```
redwoodctl capacity claim --region eu-west1 --model H100 --serial H100-serial-HT3A21B4 --tenant demo-eu-west1 --ttl 10800
```

maria: Copy. I'll prepare the quota request body now. @aj can you confirm network/route parity for the demo tenant so we don't hit firewall surprises?

aj: Will check VPC and route tables in the demo project. Quick command I run: `gcloud compute routes list --filter='network:demo-vpc'` — will post results in 5.

aj: Route table looks fine, no deny rules for that window. One note: the telemetry agent on rack-17 hasn't reported GPU temp metrics since last firmware push — recommend a smoke run after claim.

tom: Good call. I'll queue a smoke test script once claim is done. Script snippet: 
```
python tools/smoke/gpu_health.py --serial H100-serial-HT3A21B4 --run 3m
```

maria: Drafting the quota ticket now: includes serials from kelsey, window 16:00-18:00 UTC, demo tenant, TTL 3h. Adding @sree for fast-track.

alesha: If customs clears early, vendor will flip the manifest flag and infra can proceed. I've asked customs contact for a status update. Will update ticket.

vendor-ops-bot: Customs status: 'in transit to branch office' — estimated clearance 9-12 hours. No immediate flip.

maria: Ack. If clearance slips, plan B: use 4 A40s in eu-west1 + note latency diff to customer. Can we precompute perf delta? @tom can you run quick perf delta between H100 and A40 for our model?

tom: Yep. I'll run a short perf probe against the model container and post numbers in thread. If we need to ship A40s, we'll add a note in the demo script.

maria: Thanks all. I'll update INFRA-4982 with claim request and include the `redwoodctl` snippet. Will ping again once customs flips. :thumbsup:

aj: LGTM. If customs doesn't clear, I'll reserve the A40s as fallback and tag the demo engineering on the ticket.

maria: Closing loop — planning to claim as soon as vendor flips the manifest. If anyone wants to be pre-assigned for the smoke test, say so here.

sree: I'll take smoke test ownership.

kelsey: I'll keep an eye on the manifest S3 and paste updates.

maria: Perfect. Thanks everyone.
